kind: read-only lexical static dependency input; not executable validation or runtime evidence

scanner.relativeResolution: Only specifiers starting with dot and ending exactly .js; posix normpath(join(dirname(nativePath),specifier)). No extension guessing, index fallback, aliases, package resolution, query/fragment stripping or symlink canonicalization.
scanner.overlay: Replace all five root static import lists with fixed c5 TS source lists; keep every matched module edge including declaration/inline type-only bindings. All non-root adjacency comes only from restored native JS. Preserve the separate all-native graph.
scanner.closure: Breadth-first traversal from each root including itself; de-duplicate paths; follow only resolved relative .js static edges. Missing files recorded, not silently counted.
scanner.deferred: Scan every recorded native JS plus the five c5 TS roots for import/require with a literal first string argument; record only, do not traverse these edges.
scanner.lexicalLimit: Raw regex over text without AST or comment/string stripping; false positives/omitted unsupported syntax remain possible. This is not complete TypeScript, runtime, package, registry or computed-import closure.
